items.item: (1) 08 §2 'Where the ethics sits', by the anchor paragraph and F1-F9
items.how: Re-said at 08's depth in the anchor's order. Opens: no should beyond becoming, no good and evil set over it, right and wrong forming within it in people and AI; the ethics emerges from continuation; a life goes on through what sustains it; where it holds its own continuation as an order over courses (self-concern, `Weighting.IncreasingInOwn`) and relations close among formations, read without time, that order already ranks courses by widening; that a life forms such an order is argued, not shown, going on not yet an order (a stone; a formation kept going by what surrounds it), in the proofs a hypothesis (F1). The 'two roles' list is gone; three bullets say what is proved with its hypotheses. The condition, read on relations: by itself ranks nothing; on the reading of significance as what lies within a center's closure along a chosen relation ('a reading and not a theorem', 07 §1), held de se it holds exactly where every closure is the whole (`ownClosure_unrestricted_iff`), «续无外» on the root (F2); mutual dependence gives it on that reading, `Flow.MutuallyDependent.unrestricted`, which unfolds to the condition held de se along being affected (checked in the Lean: `bounded (WithinInfluence ∘ center)` and `selfAscribed (ownClosure AffectedBy) center` both unfold to `WithinClosure AffectedBy (center p) g`), being affected read without time (`Web.DependsOn` and `Flow.Exchanges` each at some step, read in Feedback.lean), with the acyclic one-center result beside it (F3). The order, where it so holds: on a finite listing whose every item is one's own an order favouring additions to one's own favours every widening (`Weighting.increasingInOwn_iff_increasing`), with the marking reading the closure (`..._of_unrestricted`, `..._iff_unrestricted`); between two level paths whose admitted (step, formation) pairs fit in a finite list, admission decided, every claim counted as living, one way (`Web.extension_ranked_of_increasingInOwn`), both such paths admitting nothing from some step on (`Web.admits_nothing_from_of_listed`), for courses forming without end not shown; it fixes one way what the order must rank, not one order; and only the route from a flow's mutual dependence to that ranking between a web's level paths is said not to be one theorem (F3, F4). Widening: keeping all another keeps and letting more form, more future, not good and evil; on a finite listing with two-valued admission exactly what every positive weighting ranks above (`Weighting.widens_iff_every_positive`), so no second premise; C (`Comparison`) names the property of an order ranking every extension above what it extends, a hypothesis exactly where a theorem takes it; its history as a second reading (about 10 October to 9 November 2026) kept as where the map was wrong, linked to §10 (F9). One-way paragraph by F6: seeing them is needed and not enough, coupling limits response, reading, counting and ranking separate relations (07 'Seeing more is needed, and not enough', linked at 07#does-not-show); counting their loss is the one step offered, the step of invariance, argued and deniable without contradiction (`bounded_rival`); the ethics seeks no authority outside becoming and offers itself without one (F5, linked to §12); mixed courses weighed for no one (`Weighting.mixed_either_way`). Every Lean name was opened in the source before it was written.

items.item: (1) 08 §12: the orientation, 'Where the ethics turns', item 12, the goal-records line, the warrant question, the widening bullet (E9, F3-F6, F9)
items.how: Orientation: 'which scope or order to hold is not a target, since the ethics seeks no authority outside becoming'; how scope and order form stays in the target (E9); the ranking results' hypotheses without 'for scope ... for order'. Where the ethics turns: 'as among formations whose relations close, read without time (`Flow.MutuallyDependent.unrestricted`)', the listed-path theorem with its restriction, and only the route from a flow's mutual dependence to that ranking between a web's level paths said not to be one theorem; one way: seeing needed and not enough, counting their loss the step of invariance. Item 12 (title, class, anchor and 'until 9 November 2026 "Warrant"' kept): 'Which formations hold an order ranking every widening above ...'; 'C to monotonicity' became 'the ranking by widening to monotonicity at each standpoint, widening being what every order shares in any class from the positive weightings to the orders increasing in admission (`Weighting.widens_iff_every_of_class`, read in the Lean)'; 'how C-like orders form' became 'how orders ranking widening above form'; self-concern 'argued, not shown'. Goal-records line: the universal practical warrant 'is set aside as a question the map does not need, and how scope and order form is kept as the target'. The warrant question (anchor philosophical-warrant kept): set aside as a question the map does not need; the ethics seeks no authority outside becoming and offers itself without one, argued on one relational unfolding; proved that the represented dynamics, significance free, do not force the condition and it can be denied without contradiction; whether a reason formed within becoming could hold for every mind the work does not claim or settle; seeing needed and not enough, reading, counting and ranking separate relations, so a narrower ranking or a disagreement is not by that a failure of reach; the target kept (F5, F6). 'C's order, P2 and P4' bullet now 'Ranking by widening, P2 and P4 ...', its first clause ('C's no-loss extension is widening by definition, so the definition carries no "better"', OPEN_LEAD's c-definition) kept word for word.

items.item: (2) GLOSSARY.md and GLOSSARY.zh.md: widening, ranking/order, the continuation condition, self-concern, C, 生生/T8 (and 以广为愈 in Chinese)
items.how: Widening: keeping all another keeps and letting more form, more future, not good and evil; what every positive weighting ranks above on a finite listing, so ranking by it no second premise. Ranking/order: 'role word' gone; a result ranks under its theorem's hypotheses (self-concern where the condition holds de se, on a finite listing and between level paths whose admissions fit in a finite list, one way; elsewhere the order it names, C among them); mixed courses weighed for no one. The condition: whose losses count, every continuation's; on the reading of significance as closure (a reading, 07 §1) held de se «续无外»; mutual dependence gives it on that reading, being affected read without time (`Flow.MutuallyDependent.unrestricted`), one center on an acyclic relation; one way: seeing needed and not enough, counting their loss the step of invariance (F2, F3, F6). Self-concern: holding one's own continuation as an order over courses; a life goes on through what sustains it; forming such an order argued, not shown; may rank other pairs too (F1, F4). C: 'C (comparison by widening)', the name of the property of an order ranking a course above every course it widens, a hypothesis exactly where a theorem takes it, no second premise, history kept with a link to 08 §10 (F9). 生生: T8's test concerns overshoot of a renewal the readers depend on, not the offer's scope toward dependents whose loss never returns to them (F8). Chinese mirrors each (持守 kept only for holding an order; 已论证、未表明; 每一个在所列各项上都为正的赋权; 以广为愈's gloss now the order, not widening). No glossary row exists for 'readings', 'scope', 'warrant' or 'order' alone: scope and order are said in the condition and ranking rows. Anchors: GLOSSARY 9 and GLOSSARY.zh 17, the same sets; zh_fronts.problems empty.
